said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

On this Veterans Day, I proudly voted to force the House Republican Leadership to finally bring the Major Richard Star Act to the House Floor. 

This bill will end the penalty in current law that forces nearly 60,000 combat-injured veterans who retired before completing 20 years of service to forfeit the military retirement pay that they have earned just to receive VA disability compensation. 

I am grateful to our Veterans Service Organizations for their relentless advocacy to ensure that 218 House Members, including five Republicans, signed the discharge petition to advance this legislation and I look forward to voting in favor of the Major Richard Star Act when it comes up for a vote tomorrow.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
